slots.words: The One who made every ocean gasped two words on a cross:
slots.note: clip carries a passing clip_qc sidecar (real look)

slots.words: "My strength is dried up like a potsherd;
slots.note: clip carries a passing clip_qc sidecar (real look)

slots.words: and my tongue cleaveth to my jaws;
slots.note: clip carries a passing clip_qc sidecar (real look)

slots.words: and thou hast brought me into the dust of death."
slots.note: clip carries a passing clip_qc sidecar (real look)

slots.words: Then John records the dying Jesus' cry:
slots.note: clip carries a passing clip_qc sidecar (real look)

slots.words: the One who made every river and spring,
slots.note: clip carries a passing clip_qc sidecar (real look)

slots.words: who offers the world living water —
slots.note: clip carries a passing clip_qc sidecar (real look)
clip carries a passing clip_qc sidecar (real look)

slots.words: He went dry so that you could drink and never thirst again.
slots.note: clip carries a passing clip_qc sidecar (real look)

slots.words: The God who made every ocean cried out in thirst —
slots.note: clip carries a passing clip_qc sidecar (real look)

slots.words: so He could hand you the one water that never fails.
slots.note: clip carries a passing clip_qc sidecar (real look)
